publications.abstract: A PIR detector wakes a high-power sensing element for a fixed window.
publications.description: A battery-powered occupancy sensor keeps its high-power sensing element off. A passive infrared detector wakes the high-power element for a fixed observation window when motion is detected, and the element is switched off again if no occupant is classified within the window.

independent_claims.quote: A battery-powered occupancy sensor comprising a passive infrared detector and a high-power sensing element, wherein the passive infrared detector wakes the high-power sensing element for a fixed observation window upon detecting motion, and the high-power sensing element is switched off if no occupant is classified within the window.

publications.title: Low-power occupancy sensor with motion-triggered sensing window

publications.abstract: The sensor transmits only on a change of count, with a periodic heartbeat.
publications.description: A battery-powered occupancy sensor keeps its high-power sensing element off. A passive infrared detector wakes the high-power element for a fixed observation window when motion is detected, and the element is switched off again if no occupant is classified within the window. The sensor transmits a message only when the occupant count changes, and transmits a heartbeat message at a fixed interval so that a silent sensor is distinguishable from a failed one.

independent_claims.quote: A battery-powered occupancy sensor configured to transmit a message only when an occupant count changes, and to transmit a heartbeat message at a fixed interval when the count has not changed.

publications.title: Low-power occupancy sensor with event-driven reporting
